title: 米夕食会銃撃　容疑者は名門理系大卒「ごく普通」から過激暴力に
extracted_text: 4月25日に米ホワイトハウス記者会主催の夕食会で起きた銃撃事件で、トランプ大統領に対する暗殺未遂罪などで訴追されたコール・アレン容疑者（31）の人物像に注目が集まっている。西部カリフォルニア州にある理系の名門大学出身で、暴力や犯罪歴はなく、周囲からは「礼儀正しい青年」と評価されていた。 アレン容疑者と大学時代の友人だった女性は、米紙ワシントン・ポストの取材にこう答えた。アレン容疑者は名門のカリフォルニア工科大学で機械工学を学び、さらに別の大学院でコンピューター科学の修士号も取得していた。知的で穏やかな性格で、…
translated_text: Attention is focusing on the profile of suspect Cole Allen (31), who has been charged with attempted assassination of President Trump following a shooting at a dinner hosted by the White House Correspondents' Association on April 25. Allen is a graduate of a prestigious science and engineering university in California and had no history of violence or criminal activity, with those around him describing him as a "polite young man." A woman who was friends with Allen during their university years told the Washington Post in an interview that Allen had studied mechanical engineering at the prestigious California Institute of Technology and later earned a master's degree in computer science at another graduate school. He was known for being intelligent and mild-mannered...
title_en: US Dinner Shooting; Suspect Graduated from Prestigious STEM University, Went from 'Completely Ordinary' to Radical Violence
